title: Nephew kills aunt for 'locking up' grandma in Bukidnon

blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — What started as a domestic dispute over a locked door ended in tragedy on Thursday morning, after a 45-year-old woman was stabbed to death by her nephew in Barangay Migcawayan, Damulog, Bukidnon. The Damulog municipal police station, under officer-in-charge Capt. Marlon Subarian, said the incident happened at around 8:50 a.m. in Purok 3. Master Sgt. Jeffry Plaida, the case investigator, told the Inquirer over the phone that the victim and the 35-year-old male suspect—who are aunt and nephew—live as neighbors in the area.
